title: Medieval Defense
description: Adds cool-looking and more durable medieval style blocks and traps.
body:
Use code **Radboi** to get 25% off your first month with [Bisect Hosting](https://bisecthosting.com/Radboi)
![Bisect Hosting discount](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d1dad3ad79a9c79b75b0a86ae03e5f6b3befe928_0.webp)

Currently adds 5 new castle brick blocks with their respective stairs, slabs, walls and even doors and trapdoors. The castle bricks are all much harder to break and can't be broken faster with any tool, thus being great for building walls and castles, that keep intruders outside. The doors and trapdoors are also hard to break and camouflage well into surrounding castle bricks.

There are also wooden beams that are much harder to break than normal wood.

The mod also adds normal bear traps and camouflaged bear traps that look like carpets along with other things useful in defending your castle.
